column4: I finished setting up Google OAuth authentication. The login flow and callback are working locally.
I'm currently working on the authentication flow. I've got the Google OAuth login working, but I haven't finished the callback handling yet.
I finished the Expense API. It currently supports GET, POST, and DELETE for expenses.
Expense API documentation: GET /expenses retrieves expenses; POST /expenses creates an expense; DELETE /expenses/:id removes an expense. Responses are JSON.
The balance calculation is currently blocked because I'm not sure whether pending expenses should be included.
I think we should use PostgreSQL for the database because the relational structure fits the project.
I thought we had decided to use MongoDB. I already started setting up the MongoDB connection.
Conflict detected: John proposed PostgreSQL while Mary proceeded with MongoDB. The database decision is unresolved.
I'm starting work on the dashboard once the Expense API is ready.
Authentication is required before users can access their expenses.
The dashboard should display total expenses and current balance.
I haven't started the dashboard yet.
I can take over the balance calculation if nobody else is working on it.
The balance calculation should probably be income minus expenses, but I'm waiting for the team to confirm how pending expenses should work.
Expense API handoff notes: implementation is complete. The API is ready for consumers. The dashboard can begin integrating with it.
The authentication implementation is complete and ready for integration.
